summary.result: The optimal dredge amount was calculated on the basis of the distribution of frequency, taking into account the design criteria for agricultural water with the 10-year frequency of resistant capacity.
summary.background: The runoff feature was calculated by utilizing the water balance simulation from DIROM (Daily Irrigation Reservoir Operation Model), which allowed changes in landuse to be quantified using remote sensing for 14 years.
summary.method: The distribution of prospective sediment deposits was been tallied based on the changes in landuse, and quantity of incoming sediment estimated.
